function.description: Re-read the current page without changing it.
function.name: observe

function.description: Wait briefly for bounded page loading, then observe again.
function.name: wait_for

function.description: Scroll the current page vertically by a bounded number of viewports, then inspect the fresh observation.
function.name: scroll

function.description: Mark one named interactive control from the latest ready page and hand control to the person. This ends the turn without clicking or submitting. Use it only when the person must complete the remaining action themselves.
function.name: highlight

function.description: End the task. Use done=false if you cannot complete it.
function.name: finish

why.description: the user reads this as your reply unless you already replied in plain text: write it to the user, in the user's language, as the reply itself rather than a note about what you did, and without tool or field names

function.description: Declare the requested page state before acting on it: the exact same-application path to arrive at, the visible control names that must show as selected (a tab, an option), active filter names, active group names, and names of observed active filters that must be removed, or a combination. Declare every condition the request names: a request to open a page and then switch a tab has both a path and a selected control. When a fresh page shows the declared state the server says so, and a pure page-navigation request can finish. Continue other requested reads or observations before finishing a mixed request. Declaring a target grants no permission; clicks and navigation are checked as before.
function.name: set_target

filters.description: exact names of active page filters

filters_absent.description: exact names of filters to remove; each must first be observed active in this turn

groups.description: exact names of active page groups

path.description: exact same-application path, optionally with its query, e.g. /orders/42

selected.description: names of controls that must show as selected or checked, exactly as the page observation names them

function.description: Look up the deployed release's source: what a field and its values mean, when an operation is refused, which screens exist and what they list. Returns bounded cited lines, then a fresh page. Source states release rules, not current records or proof of a saved write.
function.name: lookup_source

query.description: Concrete search terms in the language of the source or documentation: record, field, status, action or screen names. Preserve the user's terms; this lexical search does not translate. Use code identifiers when known.

function.description: Read bounded local Git metadata for the deployed source commit. Distinguishes a CODEOWNERS declaration, line blame, commits touching one file, and bounded diffs between the deployed and a target commit. Git authorship is not current ownership and cannot explain why a live business event occurred.
function.name: lookup_source_history

function.description: Open a same-origin read-only request that a prior lookup_source result explicitly cited. The server validates that source declared it view-only.
function.name: open_source_route

url.description: Exact relative path, including only query values established by current evidence.

function.description: Click an element from the current observation.
function.name: click

expect_navigation.description: only for a control that navigates by script rather than by href; a navigation that does not commit ends the run as uncertain

function.description: Type a value into a text field.

function.description: Submit the form that contains this element.

expect_navigation.description: only for a form submitted by script; a navigation that does not commit ends the run as uncertain
